title: Prompt injection scan only inspects a 16 KiB prefix
description: The injection detector limits regex inspection to the first 16 KiB of joined prompt content. A directive after padding is not detected, but the limit may be an intentional availability tradeoff rather than a security defect.
reasoning: The bounded scan is an explicit hot-path availability tradeoff with regression coverage. Prompt-injection pattern detection is heuristic rather than a complete security boundary, so positioning a directive after padding does not independently establish a directly triggerable security vulnerability.

ignore_hypothetical_misuse.reason: Relies on treating best-effort heuristic detection as a complete access-control boundary.

require_strict_reproducibility.reason: No concrete privileged consequence beyond bypassing a heuristic classifier was established.

history.note: Requires independent review of the stated security contract and exploit impact.
Rejected: explicitly bounded heuristic scan does not by itself demonstrate a security-boundary bypass.
